description: Fetch one BedrockNews story by id. Returns the transformed article plus its full structured analysis (GRIN scores, extraction graph, key stats, trajectory, what-to-watch). Pass fields:'grin' to get just the analysis payload without the heavy body text. Story ids contain slashes (e.g. 'ledger/2026/apr/06/iran-war-math-doesnt-work') — pass them verbatim.

fields.description: Optional projection: 'grin' for the analysis-only view

id.description: The story id, verbatim (ids contain slashes)

name: get_article
title: Read a story
